profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer | Backend & Distributed Systems
profile.summary: Ananya Rao is a backend engineer with 6 years of experience building payment and lending services in Python. She has worked with various companies, including Razorfin Payments and LendQuick, and has expertise in designing and building APIs, event pipelines, and microservices. She has also mentored junior engineers and led design reviews.

experience.title: Senior Software Engineer
highlights: Designed and built the refunds and settlement APIs in Python and FastAPI, handling 4M requests per day.
Introduced Kafka-based event pipeline for transaction status updates, cutting reconciliation lag from 6 hours to 15 minutes.
Optimised PostgreSQL queries and partitioned the ledger table, reducing p95 latency by 40%.
Mentored three junior engineers and led design reviews for the payouts team.

experience.title: Software Engineer
highlights: Built loan-disbursal microservices with Django REST Framework and PostgreSQL.
Containerised services with Docker and deployed them to AWS ECS; set up CI/CD with GitHub Actions.
Implemented RabbitMQ workers for asynchronous KYC verification.

experience.title: Associate Engineer
highlights: Maintained internal Java reporting tools and wrote SQL reports.
